Hi, I’m Mina Castellan, and I’m a data-focused freelancer with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization.

I’m interested in your HOA document ingester website and management system because it combines secure web workflows with structured data handling and visualization. While my background is centered on data analysis and reporting, I can bring a strong foundation in organizing data, building clear dashboards, and supporting reliable data flow between systems.

I’m comfortable working with SQL-driven data structures, cleaning and preparing data for processing, and creating visual outputs that make information easier to review. I’d be glad to collaborate with your development and ML teams to support database-ready data handling and user-friendly reporting within the application.

I’d love to discuss how I can contribute.
